sources.title: Introduction to Model Registry | Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform ...
sources.snippet: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Model Registry is a central repository for managing the lifecycle of ML models, supporting custom models, AutoML data types, and BigQuery ML models, offering a streamlined interface to organize, track, train, and deploy models to production.
